verdict.rationale: pnpm supports lockfiles with frozen-install/CI enforcement, overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml, catalogs for pinning shared versions, and packageManager/devEngines pinning of Node itself, all of which are respected during install (frozen-lockfile, --offline, --update-checksums controls). missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of pin enforcement across edge cases, and clearer detail on per-dependency exact-version pinning (save-exact) beyond catalogs/overrides.
